bugs.name: quorum-off-by-one
bugs.note: Upstream 163a55f: an even cluster commits on half its nodes. Only even configurations run different code. Within raft's fault model no black-box check can see it: a commit quorum of 2 still meets every election quorum of 3, so Leader Completeness holds. It loses writes only if a node forgets what it acknowledged (amnesia, outside the model: TestDSTQuorumOffByOneScripted).

bugs.name: vote-twice
bugs.note: A node grants a second vote in a term it already voted in (the duplicate-vote check is skipped).

bugs.name: vote-ignores-log
bugs.note: The election restriction is skipped (Raft §5.4.1): votes and pre-votes go to candidates whose logs are behind.

bugs.name: accept-stale-leader
bugs.note: AppendEntries from an older term is accepted (the receiver steps down and takes its entries).

bugs.name: skip-prev-log-term
bugs.note: AppendEntries' consistency check compares only the previous index, not its term (log matching, §5.3).

bugs.name: readindex-without-barrier
bugs.note: Client: ReadIndex reads served before the leader has committed an entry in its term (§8).

bugs.name: commit-previous-term
bugs.note: The leader commits an entry of an earlier term by counting replicas (Raft Figure 8).

bugs.name: compact-past-snapshot
bugs.note: Log compaction deletes entries after the snapshot's last index.

bugs.name: nonvoter-can-lead
bugs.note: Upstream 656e6c0 with 6b4e320's suffrage checks: a non-voter campaigns, and voters grant it votes.

bugs.name: lease-counts-nonvoters
bugs.note: Upstream 6e41709: the leader lease counts non-voters (and itself twice) toward a quorum.

bugs.name: two-changes-in-flight
bugs.note: A membership change is accepted while another is uncommitted (single-server changes must go one at a time).

bugs.name: config-change-before-noop
bugs.note: A new leader accepts a membership change before committing an entry of its term (the raft-dev single-server change bug, 2015).
